headline: 1 killed as bus crashes into hospital premises in Dhaka
summary: A bus lost control and crashed into the Kurmitola Hospital premises, leaving one person dead.
details: A tragic accident occurred when a bus lost control and crashed into the premises of Kurmitola Hospital in Dhaka.
One person was killed in the crash, according to reports.
The incident happened as the vehicle veered off course and entered the hospital grounds, causing significant damage to the front of the bus.
Local authorities are investigating the cause of the accident to determine why the driver lost control of the vehicle.
caption:
A bus lost control and crashed into a hospital in Dhaka, leaving one dead.

A tragic accident occurred when a bus lost control and crashed into the premises of Kurmitola Hospital in Dhaka.

One person was killed in the crash, according to reports.

The incident happened as the vehicle veered off course and entered the hospital grounds, causing significant damage to the front of the bus.

Local authorities are investigating the cause of the accident to determine why the driver lost control of the vehicle.

headline: Boxer Rakib Hossain reaches Commonwealth Games quarter-finals
summary: The Bangladeshi boxer secured a 5-0 victory over Papua New Guinea's Michael Inoino to enter the final eight.
details: Bangladeshi boxer Rakib Hossain has successfully advanced to the quarter-finals of the men's 55kg weight category at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland.
On Sunday, July 26, he secured a dominant 5-0 point victory over Michael Inoino of Papua New Guinea.
Rakib, a member of the Bangladesh Army, has been involved in boxing for nearly two decades, and his experience was evident in his recent performance.
Earlier in the 'round of 32', he defeated Tetekana Clinton of the Solomon Islands to ensure his place in the round of 16.
Rakib will now face Australia's Jay Dixon in the quarter-finals on Tuesday, July 28, keeping the hope of a medal alive.
caption:
A dominant 5-0 win! Rakib Hossain storms into the Commonwealth Games quarter-finals.

Bangladeshi boxer Rakib Hossain has successfully advanced to the quarter-finals of the men's 55kg weight category at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, Scotland.

On Sunday, July 26, he secured a dominant 5-0 point victory over Michael Inoino of Papua New Guinea.

Rakib, a member of the Bangladesh Army, has been involved in boxing for nearly two decades, and his experience was evident in his recent performance.

Earlier in the 'round of 32', he defeated Tetekana Clinton of the Solomon Islands to ensure his place in the round of 16.

Rakib will now face Australia's Jay Dixon in the quarter-finals on Tuesday, July 28, keeping the hope of a medal alive.

Source: Jamuna TV, Prothom Alo
